can pick emails from the queue; every channel opens a ticket on its own; search boxes on every list; Arrears wallboards and dashboards; Partner Academy courses for eight modules; and inbound call records without a cost.

Email pick mode: a queue can let its agents choose their own emails instead of handing each one out. On the queue's page, under Routing, set Email to Agents pick from the queue. Waiting emails then show on the desk under Email, in Waiting in your queues, oldest first, and Take makes the email and its ticket the agent's. Agents see only emails they could have been given, and a supervisor can still give one to anyone from the Live monitor.

Tickets on every channel: Open a ticket for each new conversation now covers WhatsApp, SMS, social messages and web chat as well as email, and is on by default. The ticket opens before the customer is answered, so the AI, the agent and the first reply can all give its number. A mailbox or channel that never had the setting changed starts opening tickets after this update: switch it off on alert, system and internal mailboxes.

Search on every list: list pages across the admin console, the platform console and the agent desk have a search box, and the longest lists search on the server, so a match on a later page is found.

Arrears: wallboard tiles, Arrears floor, Client and Manager dashboards and an Arrears floor wallboard; every report figure and tile opens the accounts behind it; and an Arrears wallboard or dashboard TV link can be tied to one client, with no money or person names shown.

Module customers: an agent with a module's "own customers only" right now sees customer details only for their own customers in that module, including guardians and co-tenants on Arrears accounts.

Partner Academy: sales and setup courses for BPO, Insurance, Property, Emergency response, Bookings, Betting, Automotive and Hospitality, each with walkthroughs and an exam.

Billing: inbound call attempts are recorded as inbound with no carrier cost, older records are corrected, and Imara finds the number that was called. The usage list marks inbound minutes that are not billed, and statement counts and reseller and platform dashboards leave them out.

Virus scanning: files customers send by email, chat, message or form are scanned before an agent can open them, and an infected file shows as Blocked with the virus's name. It is listed as available in the Marketplace.

Fixes: two people booking the same slot at once no longer see an error, the second is told the slot is taken."}
